map.十二平均律每品升半音：f = 空弦频率 × 2^(品/12)。高音 E 弦空弦: In twelve-tone equal temperament each fret raises by a semitone: f = open string frequency × 2^(fret/12). The high E string open E4 = 329.63 Hz, and the 12th fret = 329.63×2 = 659.26 Hz (E5, exactly one octave up).
map.从低到高 E2(82.41) A2(110) D3(146.83) G3(196: From low to high: E2 (82.41), A2 (110), D3 (146.83), G3 (196), B3 (246.94), E4 (329.63). The 5th fret of the low E string is A2 (110 Hz), the same note as the adjacent string's open string, which lets you cross-check.
map.为什么第 12 品是高八度？: Why Is the 12th Fret One Octave Up?
map.12 个半音 = 一个八度，频率×2^(12/12)=×2，故空弦第 12 品正: 12 semitones make one octave, and frequency ×2^(12/12) = ×2, so the 12th fret is exactly double the open string, on every string.
map.空弦频率怎么记？: How Do You Memorize Open String Frequencies?
map.标准调弦低到高 E A D G B E；相邻弦（除 G-B 为纯四度+小三度）多: Standard tuning from low to high is E A D G B E. Adjacent strings are mostly a perfect fourth apart (5 semitones), except G to B which is a perfect fourth plus a minor third. Remembering E2/A2/D3/G3/B3/E4 lets you derive every fret.
